# parascopy_models_v1.7.txt: every region of the 167 genes the pinned Parascopy data models
# (PARASCOPY_DATA_VERSION 1.7 in versions.env), one region per line: gene, region as Parascopy writes
# it (1-based, both ends included), and main (the model's "main" line, one per gene) or copy (the
# paralog copies its "duplication" lines name, overlapping ones merged). A model counts every copy
# region too: RHCE's copies cover most of RHD, C4A's copy covers C4B.
# From models_GRCh38_1KGP_v1.7.tar.gz of Zenodo record 15019940 (md5 244110d8fa883cf11334527ec2383498,
# the archive setup.sh --parascopy-data installs), folder EUR; AFR, AMR, EAS and SAS hold the same
# 167 models with the same regions (checked 2026-10-27).
# tests/test_copy_number.py reads it: a row of bin/cn_loci.tsv whose targets or controls overlap one
# of these regions fails, unless the test's short list of exemptions names that row and model.
